summary: Large sealed golf club car park, bush behind, nearest homes about 80 m off.
reasons: Big sealed car park, plenty of room

best_section.where: Western bays of the golf club car park, away from the clubhouse

drivers.seclusion: Bush to the west and south, golf course east; new homes lie about 80 m north-east, beyond the clubhouse.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed drive off Minnippi Boulevard into a large lot; no barrier seen, plenty of van-length bays.
drivers.traffic: Internal club road only; light traffic outside opening hours.
drivers.convention: Dozens of cars parked in the Esri image, so a van fits in by day.

flags: Clubhouse and restaurant 9 m from the ring; busy in the day
Venue may close or patrol the lot at night
Slope: about 3 to 6% across the site
Low-lying: about 7 m elevation, water 56 m away
sun_shade: Open sealed lot in full sun; bush shades the western edge in the afternoon.
